Full night’s rest: recover from normal wounds and fatigue equal to Toughness, plus recover stress equal to Willpower. End of episode or encounter is just fatigue (Tou) & stress (WP) recovery. A critical wound recovery check:

Convert critical to normal wound if number of 4s = critical severity. Target may benefit from assistance from a Medicine or First Aid check at (2{Df}). Add +9 if target of assistance check is self. Wounds equal to M. Difficulty for all Resilience checks is minus 19. hospital. Automatic check if tended by person with Medicine trained. Healing Draught: Heal wounds equal to Change critical to normal wound if Subtract 19 difficulty if you are in a hospital. Long-Term Care (in hospital only): As above plus, make resilience check to recover additional to severity. Target may benefit from each specific healing only once per day (PG:89).
